desc: Ideate approaches and select the Fenwick difference-array method over the forward lazy segment tree.
Implement a Fenwick tree over indices 1..500000 initialized to the difference array of the identity sequence (all ones).
Implement point_add and prefix_sum operations for the Fenwick tree.
Implement lower_bound(target) returning the smallest index whose prefix sum is at least target, or 500001 if none exists.
For each contest [L, R], compute l = lower_bound(L) and r = lower_bound(R + 1) - 1; if l <= r, apply point_add(l, 1) and, if r < 500000, point_add(r + 1, -1).
Answer each query X by printing prefix_sum(X).
Handle edge cases: empty contest ranges, r at the maximum index, targets larger than the total sum, and final ratings exceeding 500000.
Run the provided sample tests to verify correctness.
